question: Who among the following was appointed as the Acting Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission in April 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prafulla Chandra Pant.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Prafulla Chandra Pant was appointed as the Acting Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission in April 2021.
 
• The President of India has authorized Justice Prafulla Chandra Pant, Member, National Human Rights Commission, NHRC India__, to act as its Chairperson.
 
• His appointment was in effect from 25 April 2021.
 
• Prio**r** to his appointment as the Member of NHRC on 22 April, 2019, Justice Pant was a Judge of the Supreme Court of India from 13th August 2014 to 29th August 2017.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] 

**__Confusion Points__**

 
• Arun Kumar Mishra is the current and eighth Chairperson of the National Human Rights Commission of India. (Apr 2022)
